paragraphs: Apple’s first-ever foldable iPhone is now available for pre-order. You can head to Apple’s website or the Apple Store app this morning to place your iPhone Duo pre-order, with the first orders arriving in one week on October 23.
Apple is bringing the Apple Store back online in waves, so if you don’t have the option to pre-order iPhone Duo just yet, keep waiting.

As a refresher, iPhone Duo features a 5.4-inch outer display that unfolds into a 7.6-inch inner display. It’s powered by Apple’s A20 Pro chip. It has a dual-camera system on the back, including a 48MP Main camera and a 48MP Ultra Wide camera. There’s a Center Stage camera on the front, as well as a FaceTime camera underneath the inner display.
Here’s Apple on some of the software optimizations for the foldable iPhone Duo:

The expansive display on iPhone Duo supercharges productivity with Split View multitasking and seamless app switching, and a reimagined yet familiar iOS experience introduces entirely new ways to interact with iPhone.

iOS also adapts to content on iPhone Duo by reacting as it folds, reorienting when turned to the side, and switching to the appropriate display when flipped over. iPhone Duo can also enter StandBy on either the outer or inner display — even when it’s not charging — turning the device into a photo frame, a hub for widgets, a clock, and more.
Got my order in at 8:01 (fastest I could get the app or page to load) and it was already Nov 2-9
iPhone Duo is available in two colors: star white and night sky. Pricing starts at $1,999 for the 256GB model.
